title: wsutil: Add filesystem write_file_binary_mode()
description:
Add a generic function to write content to file. Use this on write
TLS session keys from UI and tshark, and for export objects.

Remove the now unused export_object_ui.[ch].

This change creates a warning on Windows x86, which is treated as an error on the [builder](https://buildbot.wireshark.org/wireshark-master/builders/Windows%20Server%202019%20x86):

    139>C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\ui\cli\tap-exportobject.c(142,89): error C2220: the following warning is treated as an error [C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\cmbuild\tshark.vcxproj]
    C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\ui\cli\tap-exportobject.c(142,89): error C2220:         write_file_binary_mode(save_as_fullpath, entry->payload_data, entry->payload_len); [C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\cmbuild\tshark.vcxproj]
    C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\ui\cli\tap-exportobject.c(142,89): error C2220:                                                                                         ^ [C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\cmbuild\tshark.vcxproj]
    139>C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\ui\cli\tap-exportobject.c(142,89): warning C4244: 'function': conversion from 'gint64' to 'size_t', possible loss of data [C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\cmbuild\tshark.vcxproj]
    C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\ui\cli\tap-exportobject.c(142,89): warning C4244:         write_file_binary_mode(save_as_fullpath, entry->payload_data, entry->payload_len); [C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\cmbuild\tshark.vcxproj]
    C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\ui\cli\tap-exportobject.c(142,89): warning C4244:                                                                                         ^ [C:\buildbot\builders\wireshark-master-32\windows-2019-x86\build\cmbuild\tshark.vcxproj]
I made a proposed fix in !3268

Note the comment in epan/export_object.h:

         ...

      XXX - we store the entire object in the program's address space,
      so the *real* maximum object size is size_t; if we were to export
      objects by going through all of the packets containing data from
      the object, one packet at a time, and write the object incrementally,
      we could support objects that don't fit into the address space. */

In practice, what's pointed to by the `content` argument to `write_file_binary_mode()` can never be larger than the maximum value of a `size_t`, as nothing in the process's address space can be larger than that.  (The address space *as a whole* can't be larger than that on all the platforms on which we run; on ILP32 platforms, `size_t` is a 32-bit unsigned value, and on LP64 (64-bit UN\*Xes) and LLP64 (64-bit Windows) `size_t` is a 64-bit unsigned value.)

The `payload_len` member of a `export_object_entry_t` structure presumably is a `gint64` because somewhere in the process a `gint64` value is assigned to it.
